Max 8 material items from the past Mon-Sun, grouped in this order: strategy (Strategy & Saylor), treasury (other big treasury companies: Strive/ASST, Metaplanet...), industry (index/regulatory/capital-markets news for the sector, other companies), bitcoin (price milestones, network, ETFs, adoption, crypto regulation) (omit a group with nothing material). weeks.label: Oct 12 – 18, 2026

items.text: Conditionally declared daily STRC dividends for every calendar day Nov 1–30 at a 12.00% rate ($0.03–$0.04/share a day, $1.00 in total), payable only if stockholders approve the daily-dividend amendments on Oct 28.
items.why: If the vote passes, every calendar day becomes a STRC record date and the Nov 15 semi-monthly payment falls away; if it fails, the semi-monthly schedule stays.

items.text: Bought 250 BTC (~$21.5M, avg $86,194) to reach 848,250 BTC, funded by $21.0M of MSTR sales; repurchased $192.4M of STRC (1.93M shares). No preferred ATM sales.
items.why: STRC was bought back at about $99.58 a share, just under $100 par, using cash rather than new issuance; average BTC cost is $75,444.

items.text: Strive bought 6,133 BTC in two weeks (3,311 Oct 5–9, 2,822 Oct 12–13) to reach 35,595 BTC, passing MARA (35,577) for #4 among public companies; warrant exercises brought in $369.2M.
items.why: Strive is now the fourth-largest public bitcoin holder; the warrant cash funded the buys, but it also adds about 13.7M Class A shares.

items.text: Strive priced an upsized IPO of its new 15.00% SATS perpetual preferred: 7M shares at $90 (~$630M gross), dividends each business day from Nov 9, settling Oct 20.
items.why: A second, higher-rate preferred next to SATA; at $90 on a $100 stated amount the starting yield is about 16.7%.

items.text: Metaplanet set ¥52B of zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2031 (conversion price ¥339): about ¥23.6B to repay part of its bitcoin-backed loan and up to ¥28.3B for share buybacks under a new ¥60B program.
items.why: Swaps secured, interest-bearing BTC-backed debt for unsecured debt with no coupon and frees pledged BTC; potential dilution is about 11.24% if the bonds convert.

items.text: MSCI adopted its 'non-operating companies' rule (Oct 15): issuers failing an operating-assets screen and 4 of 5 financial ratios become ineligible from the Nov 30 close. Strategy and Metaplanet are on the potential-deletion list; the final list is due Nov 11. Strategy called the rule 'discriminatory' and asked MSCI to withdraw it.
items.why: Current constituents are removed only if they fail the screen in each of their two most recent annual filings. Funds tracking MSCI hold about 13M MSTR shares (~3.1% of basic shares).

items.text: Smarter Web (SWC) listed its "MORE" preferred on the LSE Main Market (12% initial variable rate, paid weekly; £10.0M raised) and bought 83 BTC to reach 2,830 BTC.
items.why: A UK-listed take on the Strategy-style preferred model; SWC used part of the proceeds to cut its Coinbase credit line to about £16M.

items.text: US spot bitcoin ETFs had $228.4M of net outflows over Oct 12–16, including −$261.4M on Oct 14, the day September CPI came in at 3.7% a year.
items.why: ETF flows are a big source of marginal BTC demand; the Fed’s next rate decision is Oct 28, after the hotter CPI print.

weeks.label: Oct 5 – 11, 2026

items.text: Bought 334 BTC (~$28.7M, avg $85,839) to reach 848,000 BTC; estimates a $20.91B Q3 gain on digital assets.
items.why: Small buy funded by MSTR sales and cash; the Q3 mark-to-market gain is non-cash but sets the tone for Oct 29 earnings.

items.text: Repurchased $176.3M of STRC (1.77M shares) Sep 28 – Oct 4; $547.2M left in the preferred buyback program, no preferred ATM sales.
items.why: Bought back near $99.4/share, under $100 par, which supports STRC's price and uses cash instead of new issuance.

items.text: Q3 2026 results set for Thu Oct 29 after the close, live Video Webinar 5:00 PM ET (stockholder vote on daily preferred dividends Oct 28).
items.why: First full look at Q3: BTC Yield, USD Reserve coverage of dividends, and any update on the capital plan.

items.text: Strive bought 2,000 BTC (avg ~$84,422) to reach 29,462 BTC and set up a repurchase facility of up to $500M for SATA.
items.why: More BTC per ASST share is the KPI; the SATA buyback gives Strive a tool to support its preferred's price.

items.text: Metaplanet ended Q3 at 44,000 BTC (net +1,000) after selling 10,000 and buying back 11,000 to show liquidity; plans 10-15% of assets in treasury-company preferreds.
items.why: Proves it can turn BTC into cash to cover debt, a step toward a credit rating and cheaper funding; adds a buyer for treasury preferreds.

items.text: Coming: MSCI decision on 'non-operating companies' due on or before Oct 16; its simulation flagged Strategy and Metaplanet as possible index deletions.
items.why: An exclusion could force passive index funds to sell MSTR and Metaplanet; current members get a two-period buffer before removal.

items.text: US spot bitcoin ETFs saw $484.9M of net outflows, the largest day since June 25, erasing October's early inflows; BTC dipped toward $82K.
items.why: ETF flows are a big source of marginal BTC demand; sustained outflows can weigh on price and on treasury-stock premiums.

items.text: CFTC opened rulemaking (Regulation CTX and CAM) for leveraged and margined retail crypto trading, after the CLARITY Act stalled in the Senate.
items.why: Early step toward onshore federal rules for leveraged crypto trading; no direct change for spot BTC or treasury stocks yet.
